# Sprites — how far from vanilla

**Generated by `python3 tools/gbaspritecensus.py --write`; do not edit by hand.** *Measured against pret's `upstream/master` by pixel, at engine commit `71b761513`.* **Redrawn** means the drawing differs; **recoloured** is the same drawing with another palette in the PNG; **added** sprites vanilla never had and are kept out of the percentage. *The people line is the headline: every overworld figure and trainer picture a player sees, which is what 9.4's fable rule asks for.*

| sprites | vanilla shipped | redrawn | recoloured | still vanilla | added | done |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| overworld people | 89 | 87 | 0 | 2 | 58 | **98%** |
| trainer portraits | 66 | 66 | 0 | 0 | 10 | **100%** |
| trainer back pics | 6 | 4 | 0 | 2 | 0 | **67%** |
| intro portraits | 4 | 4 | 0 | 0 | 0 | **100%** |
| hearsay portraits | 6 | 6 | 0 | 0 | 0 | **100%** |
| daemon fronts | 386 | 275 | 0 | 111 | 2 | **71%** |
| daemon backs | 384 | 274 | 0 | 110 | 2 | **71%** |
| daemon icons | 387 | 275 | 0 | 112 | 1 | **71%** |
| overworld daemons | 42 | 36 | 0 | 6 | 0 | **86%** |
| overworld objects | 19 | 19 | 0 | 0 | 2 | **100%** |
| ***the people*** | 171 | 167 | 0 | 4 | 68 | ***97.7%*** |
| ***every sprite*** | 1389 | 1046 | 0 | 343 | 75 | ***75.3%*** |

## The towns

**A town's people are the sheets its maps put on screen, BENCHMARK interiors aside.** *A sheet shared with other towns can carry only one look, so a town themed to its own colour needs its own sprites where it shares* (vision.md 3.1).
